description: This is a Java source file for the NoteService class, responsible for implementing CRUD operations, validation, audit logging, and role-based access control for notes in a web application.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service class managing CRUD operations, validation, audit logs, and RBAC for Note entities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note, logs creation for audit purposes.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists notes with pagination, sorting, for the current user, with audit read logging.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a note by ID, enforces ownership or admin role, logs read access.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note, logs before/after states for audit.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note, logs delete event with previous state.

methods.name: enforceOwnershipOrAdmin
methods.description: Checks if current user is owner or admin; throws exception otherwise.

methods.name: toJsonQuiet
methods.description: Serializes object to JSON string with exception handling for audit logging.
